toolDesc.converter: Convert between Hijri and Gregorian both ways
toolDesc.age: Your age in both calendars and your next Hijri birthday
toolDesc.events: Blessed seasons and days with a countdown

age.empty: Pick your date of birth to see your age in both calendars

note: Hijri dates follow the Umm al-Qura calendar and may differ by a day with moon sighting

newYear.name: Islamic New Year
newYear.desc: The first of Muharram, the start of the new Hijri year.

ashura.name: Day of Ashura
ashura.desc: The 10th of Muharram; fasting it is Sunnah, ideally with the 9th.

ramadanStart.name: Start of Ramadan
ramadanStart.desc: The first day of the month of fasting, the month of the Quran and night prayer.

lastTen.name: Last ten nights of Ramadan
lastTen.desc: The best nights of the year, in which Laylat al-Qadr is sought.

eidFitr.name: Eid al-Fitr
eidFitr.desc: The first of Shawwal, the Muslims' Eid after completing Ramadan.

dhulHijjahTen.name: First ten days of Dhul-Hijjah
dhulHijjahTen.desc: The best days of the year; do plenty of good deeds in them.

arafah.name: Day of Arafah
arafah.desc: The great day of Hajj; fasting it is Sunnah for those not on Hajj.

eidAdha.name: Eid al-Adha
eidAdha.desc: The day of sacrifice, the greatest day of the year.

tashreeq.name: Days of Tashreeq
tashreeq.desc: Days of eating, drinking and remembering Allah after Eid al-Adha (11–13 Dhul-Hijjah).
